hard_contracts.description: The research work plane (Jetson Nano) possesses zero admission keys, zero canonical write paths, and zero scheduling override capability. Output is strictly an immutable CandidateBundle spooled to disk in PROPOSED status. All admission dispositions are produced exclusively on the regulatory control node.

H_E.definition: Evidence Payload Hash (SHA-256 over source manifest, source hashes, fragments, candidate entities, relations, claims, questions)
H_E.invariance: Remains completely invariant across execution environments, temperatures, and rerun envelopes

H_X.definition: Execution Envelope Hash (SHA-256 over uow_id, parent_uow_id, worker_id, sequence, commit, observer state, resource telemetry, and H_E)
H_X.invariance: Reflects execution-specific environment drift and hardware state

causal_issuance_ledger.definition: Decouples causal validity from completion arrival order via issuance ledger tracking (worker_id, uow_id, issued_sequence, parent_uow_id, expected_state, disposition)
causal_issuance_ledger.validity_rule: UoW was issued AND not already dispositioned AND parent state is valid

local_spooling.definition: Nano spools candidate bundles to evidence/n5/spool/candidate_bundle_<uow_id>.json allowing autonomous operation during control plane or network outages

UQ_N1_1_physical_authority_separation.description: Verified Nano research worker has no write methods; output strictly spooled CandidateBundle.

UQ_N1_2_bundle_integrity_dual_tier_hashe.description: Verified UNO Q rejects altered H_E (evidence tampering) and altered H_X (envelope tampering).

UQ_N1_3_out_of_order_concurrency.description: Verified concurrent UoWs arriving in arbitrary permutations [1,2,3,4], [4,3,2,1], [2,4,1,3], [3,1,4,2] are all admitted.

UQ_N1_4_replay_idempotent_rejection.description: Verified replayed UoW or duplicate execution hash receives REJECT_IDEMPOTENT.

UQ_N1_5_duplicate_evidence_replication_r.description: Verified identical H_E across distinct H_X is recognized as independent scientific replication (DEDUP).

UQ_N1_6_parent_state_supersession.description: Verified children of superseded or rejected parent UoWs are rejected at admission gate.

UQ_N1_7_nano_reboot_recovery.description: Verified worker reboot recovery prevents re-admission of previously dispositioned spooled bundles.

UQ_N1_8_uno_outage_local_spooling.description: Verified Nano continues autonomous research during control plane outages, spooling bundles for subsequent batch ingestion.

UQ_N1_9_network_partition_split_brain_pr.description: Verified during partition Nano cannot self-authorize; bundles remain PROPOSED until link restored.

UQ_N1_10_backpressure_signaling.description: Verified low RAM (<512 MB) or thermal limits (>75 C) trigger backpressure flag and control plane throttling.

UQ_N1_11_geometry_boundary.description: Verified G1 geometric observer remains strictly advisory in SHADOW_MODE=True; live scheduler takeover attempts trigger REFUSE.

UQ_N1_12_cryptographic_provenance_chain.description: Verified unbroken SHA-256 chain from corpus text fragment -> H_E -> H_X -> ledger issuance -> admission log.
